You and up to 5 other players must keep a falling-apart plane in the sky by fixing holes, repairing lights and pipes, regaining control, refueling, and re-oxygenating the cabin, all while chaos unfolds around you. Choose from 19 unique classes, each with their own special abilities, and see how long you can survive the madness.
